verdict.rationale: Asana's API, rules, and automation platform (asana-docs-2, asana-docs-7) imply that many tasks/projects could be updated programmatically, and MCP tools allow creating/managing tasks via natural language (asana-docs-35), but no evidence describes an explicit bulk/batch endpoint or bulk-edit UI for operating on many items at once. missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch API endpoint documentation, evidence of bulk task creation/update in one call, and independent confirmation of bulk operation performance at scale.
